name: Ring of Snaring
body:
Aura moderate abjuration; CL 7th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of freedom of movement. Once the ring is worn, hundreds of threads of force shoot forth from the ring, engulfing the wearer and securing to structures, objects and beings within 20 feet of the wearer.

Anyone within the 20 foot radius must make a DC 15 Reflex saving throw or suffer effects similar to the entangle spell.

Each five foot square of the force threads has a hardness of 10 and 20 hit points. Destroyed threads are replaced by new ones within two rounds.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it. This renders the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of freedom of movement

Identification DC 32
False Identification DC 22
